snippet.title: Jurassic Fart Simulator – Complete Dino Fart Experience (Android)
snippet.description: Experience the full gameplay of Jurassic Fart Simulator, the Android game where four fully animated dinosaurs unleash their unique flatulent abilities. Control T‑Rex, Raptor, Terry Dactyl and Brontosaurus with the on‑screen joystick as each level introduces its own fart‑powered mechanic. Shake the environment with T‑Rex’s high‑level blasts, dodge hazards with the fast‑moving Raptor, experiment with sounds and colourful clouds with Terry and Tara, and fuel Bronto’s gas by gathering berries. Created by Cliffco Graphics and available now on Google Play.
